d:
Spain delivered a STUNNING upset against USA at the 2002 FIBA World Championship!
The Americans looked in control, building a 16-point lead after a powerful start. But Spain refused to give up and mounted an INCREDIBLE comeback in the second half!
Juan Carlos Navarro led the way with 26 points, while a young Pau Gasol added 19 points and 10 rebounds. Spain turned the game around and closed it out with a decisive 9-0 run, leaving Team USA scoreless in the final 2 minutes and 38 seconds!
The final score? Spain 81, USA 75!
